requirement: DanceFlow policy: ordinal_rank@1 (plain 1..N rank per heat, no medal tiers) and the studio ordinal-majority engine are preserved and are never modified to approximate UCWDC, NDCA or WSDC. A body method needs its own separately versioned ballot format and engine.
enforcement_point: Ballot format registry (formats.ts, _compe2_format_approved, _compe2_guard_ballot_insert) and engine key/version gate in studioOrdinalMajority.ts.

tests.name: the approved ballot formats are exactly ordinal_rank@1 and callback_yes@1
a studio engine refuses an input addressed to another engine key or version

interpretation_notes: R-07(2). No engine, ballot format or registry row exists that claims or approximates medal ballots, the Skating System or Relative Placement. Application-layer behavior and static SQL parity are verified by EXECUTED tests (r07.failclosed.test.ts); the SQL runtime suites (sql-tests/test_T_competition_scoring_registry.sql, test_T_competition_e2_ballots.sql) were NOT RUN in this slice (heavy-lock queue), so the status stays unverified until their results are attached.
